finding.summary: Control enums used Object.hasOwn key coercion rather than requiring strings
finding.before: Pure buildIncrementCurve accepted an array-valued controlledQuantity with mm unit; artifact export later failed closed with an internal replaceAll TypeError
finding.after: Pure table, measurement extractor and artifact path reject non-string enums explicitly before interpretation

independentReview.actualSolveBoundary: Generator passes each valueMm constraint directly to solveElastic. Constraint assembly converts mm to m; result displacement returns mm.
independentReview.sign: Fixed-end axial reactions are negated for tensile force; actuator reactions supply the positive applied axial contribution for displacement control; external applied vector is zero.
independentReview.units: Controlled displacement mm; force N; engineering stress Pa and strain dimensionless.
independentReview.invalidMixtures: Request parser requires exactly one mode-specific sequence before meshing. Prescribed boundaries require no forces and exactly the fixed/actuator reaction node sets.
independentReview.publicTypes: Request union excludes opposite-mode arrays; MCP rows correlate control mode and unit. Actual-module fixture passes.
